regions.text: 以上は目的々偶然について逃べた。

quote.translation: So far I have discussed teleological contingency.

regions.text: 然るに目々地平における斯やうな偶然性ぁ、狭義の因果開係の見地から見れば何等かの原因の結果として生じたもので、因果的必然性を備べてゐると考ふべきである。

quote.translation: Yet contingency of this kind on the teleological horizon, seen from the standpoint of causal relation in the narrow sense, must also be considered to have arisen as the effect of some cause, and so to possess causal necessity.

regions.text: 「無目的」としての目的々消極的偶然について云へば、人間が偶然に地球の表面へ投げ出されたといふ考は、運動の法則によつて人間が必然約に生産されたといふ機械親の半面にほかならない。

quote.translation: To take first negative teleological contingency as "purposelessness", the idea that human beings were thrown by chance onto the surface of the earth is nothing other than one half of the mechanistic view, according to which human beings were produced necessarily by the laws of motion.

regions.text: 「反目的」をしての目的々消極的偶然について云へば、自痴であることは大腰の組機就中細胞の遺傳質のうちに何等かの原因を有つてるなければならない。花が入重になることは、寄生した菌頻または蟲類の刺裁作用と、それに對する花の反應作用とに一定の原因を有つてゐなければならない。

quote.translation: To take negative teleological contingency as "counter-purpose", severe intellectual disability must have some cause in the tissue of the cerebrum, and above all in the hereditary material of its cells, and a flower's becoming double must have a determinate cause in the stimulating action of parasitic fungi or insects and in the flower's reaction to it.

regions.text: 目旳々積極偶然について云ふならば、土地を掘つて寶を得たことは、不透明な土の中に静止してあた物品の有つ惰性と鍛の機械作用およびそれに加へられた人の力

quote.translation: As for positive teleological contingency, that someone dug the ground and found treasure has its cause in the inertia of the object that lay at rest in the opaque earth, and in the mechanical action of the hoe together with the human force applied to it.
